title: Ogden City General Plan (August 2002; 2020 update; consolidated adopted plan)
notes: Ogden's current adopted General Plan of record. Base plan August 2002, chapter-level updates through 2020; consolidated single PDF (847 pp, incl. sub-area/corridor plans and appendices). Born-digital text layer. Discovered on the Planning > City Plans page (/541/City-Plans). The comprehensive rewrite "Plan Ogden" (/2809) is an IN-PROGRESS project, not yet adopted, so this remains the adopted plan. Housing is Chapter 7 (published separately, see next row). Sidecar text/ogden-general-plan-2020-update.txt (1 stray replacement char in 2.7 MB; otherwise clean).

title: Ogden City General Plan Chapter 7 - Housing (Moderate Income Housing element; amended 2022)
notes: The General Plan Housing chapter ("7. Housing", August 2002 - Amended 2020, latest amendment 2022) that CONTAINS Ogden's Moderate Income Housing element and Implementation Plan (sec. G: "State Code 10-9a-403(2)(b) requires Ogden City to adopt a moderate-income housing... plan"; strategies with "Actions Taken as of 2022" and 2022-2025 timelines incl. station area plans). This is the exact file Ogden cites in its state MIH filings as the "general plan, moderate income housing element." MIH is a CHAPTER of the general plan, published as its own PDF (not a wholly standalone document). Born-digital. Sidecar text/ogden-gp-07-housing-element-amended-2022.txt.
